mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 550K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer discretionary spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 550K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 8%, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 returns turn negative over the next 60 trading days, as inflation concerns rise and the Fed may tighten.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 8%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 2% YoY, indicating strong supply chains, boosts S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as corporate earnings rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when INDPRO YoY growth > 2%, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The combination of rising housing starts (HOUST) above 500K and increasing retail sales (RSAFS) above $400B signals robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) increase above 1.5%, signaling monetary tightening, leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 1.5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment (UNRATE) below 9% maintains a labor market conducive to economic growth, supporting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns when UNRATE < 9% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth (GDPC1) above 3% YoY, combined with rising payroll employment (PAYEMS) above 200K, signals strong demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances when both triggers are met, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.
